Noor: Quick shoutout to the karaoke crew last night 1 1 for hauling the PA speakers and making the mic sound decent. Saved the after-hours vibes. :microphone: :sparkles:
Diego: shoutout to Lena for being stage manager and wrangling the playlist. also to Sam for the last-minute cable splice 4a1
Lena: team effort! Priya ran scone logistics and brought the GF batch 36f huge morale move.
AV-bot: event-log: karaoke-2026-03-22 | PA setup by Diego, stage mgmt by Lena, refreshments by Priya | no incidents reported. :white_check_mark:
Sam: mic hero duties are accepted. also carrying extra extension cords > always useful. :muscle:
Priya: tiny follow-up 1 we left a labeled box of "Kudos Scones" in the kitchen for anyone who helped last night. take one and stick a coin on the Kudos Board if you do.
Theo: coin idea = love. thinking of little cardstock tokens stamped "Karaoke MVP" and "Snack Angel". low effort, high joy.
Noor: poll: react with :coin: for tokens, :label: for stickers, :card_index: for handwritten notes.
Lena: :coin: tokens please. tactile and silly.
Diego: :label: stickers would be cute on laptops though.
Sam: volunteering to stamp 40 tokens tomorrow afternoon. who wants to assist? 10 minutes.
Priya: I can help after standup. also adding a 1-line to the Friday digest: "micro-win: karaoke setup + scone stash saved after-hours event" so Ops & Snacks get a shout.
Noor: GIF for the digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/karaoke-team-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI

Sam: will bring a mini stamp and ink pad. Priya: I'll leave the scone box with a sticky note for token claims.
Lena: extra thanks to the person who fixed the plant by the window 338 (saved its life during midnight enthusiastic dancing).
Diego: that was me 923 had to re-pot with duct-tape heroics.
